realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke executive office furniture in Rende
realizzazioni.introduzione: The new executive headquarters of a transport and logistics group, fitted out through a turnkey contract project.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the new executive headquarters of Ruffolo Group, a transport and logistics company, we delivered a complete turnkey contract fit-out based on architect Bruno Filice's concept.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: The project includes executive desks and furnishings, glazed partitions, flooring and bespoke joinery, integrated with partner-brand systems to create an image aligned with the company's identity. The goal was to balance design, ergonomics and functionality across productive, comfortable and representative workspaces.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke office furniture in Rende
realizzazioni.introduzione: Desks, storage and seating for the offices of a growing construction company.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the offices of construction company Costruzioni Imbrogno in Rende, we supplied and installed Colombini Office furniture and seating.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: The result is a well-proportioned, functional working environment combining ergonomics and clean design to support a dynamic, growing business.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke bank interior fit-out in Tarsia
realizzazioni.introduzione: Complete interior fit-out for a cooperative bank headquarters, with office furniture and glazed partitions.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the headquarters of BCC di Tarsia, we delivered the complete office fit-out, supplying and installing furniture and partition walls.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: Using Frezza systems, we created a practical, well-ordered working environment that enhances the banking setting and supports daily comfort for staff.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke conference hall furniture in Castrolibero
realizzazioni.introduzione: A representative conference hall for press conferences, institutional meetings and corporate events.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the conference hall of Il Quotidiano, we delivered a turnkey contract fit-out designed as a representative venue for press conferences, institutional meetings and corporate events.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: The project brings together bespoke joinery integrated into the hall's architecture, conference seating and acoustic wall panelling that improves speech intelligibility. The brief balanced aesthetics, ergonomics and technical performance for both speakers and audiences.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke culinary school fit-out in Fuscaldo
realizzazioni.introduzione: Bespoke furniture, tables, seating and professional catering equipment for a food and wine school.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For Ingrediente School, a food and wine school in Fuscaldo, we crafted bespoke furnishings and supplied tables, seating and professional kitchen equipment.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: Developed in close collaboration with owner Mimmo Rosselli, the fit-out combines functionality and visual clarity in a modern, fully equipped teaching space.

realizzazioni.kw: Public-sector office furniture in Cosenza
realizzazioni.introduzione: Supply and installation of office furniture for the Regional Meteorological Centre.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the Arpacal Regional Meteorological Centre in Cosenza, we managed the supply and installation of all office furnishings.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: The scheme combines About Office and Moving systems with bespoke Artes joinery, creating an efficient workspace tailored to the agency's operational requirements.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke sportswear store furniture in Amantea
realizzazioni.introduzione: A contemporary sportswear and footwear store, designed for practical day-to-day retail operations.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the Free Sport store in Amantea, we produced bespoke fixtures combining aesthetics and functionality, making full use of the floor area and showcasing apparel and footwear.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: Designed by Lucio Pellicanò and Fausto Scalercio, the interior creates a modern, welcoming store that works smoothly for staff and offers an engaging experience for customers.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke home appliance store furniture in Cosenza
realizzazioni.introduzione: The new retail outlet of a long-established home appliance and electronics retailer.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: We designed and built the new Lico store in Cosenza, a home appliance and consumer electronics retailer established in the area for decades.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: The layout was conceived to be contemporary and practical, keeping the focus squarely on the products on display.

realizzazioni.kw: Glazed partitions for a car dealership in Rende
realizzazioni.introduzione: Glazed partition walls for the showroom floor and the new service reception area of a car dealership.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the Tema Motori dealership in Rende, we designed and installed glazed partition walls across the showroom, defining separate brand zones and elevating the new reception area.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: The transparency of the glass preserves the full scale of the industrial volume while bringing natural light and visual continuity across the showroom.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke wellness and fitness store furniture in Cosenza
realizzazioni.introduzione: A wellness and fitness retail store refurbished with bespoke fixtures and display systems.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the Wellness Universe store in Cosenza, we supplied and installed retail furnishings that balance functionality and visual appeal.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: Combining bespoke joinery with HiRetail display systems, we created a refreshed, inviting retail space structured to highlight products and improve the customer journey.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke menswear store furniture in Mangone
realizzazioni.introduzione: A refined menswear boutique tailored to reflect the brand's identity.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the Perfect Man store in Mangone, we supplied bespoke fixtures designed to unite aesthetics and practicality, aligned with the brand's identity and conceived to elevate garment presentation.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: The interior focuses on ease of operation for staff and a relaxed shopping experience for customers, with close attention paid to detailing and material finishes.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke footwear store furniture in Montalto Uffugo
realizzazioni.introduzione: Bespoke display fixtures crafted to showcase the collections of a footwear boutique.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the Morgana store in Montalto Uffugo, we handled the supply and installation of retail fixtures engineered for clear, functional presentation.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: The fit-out optimised the store's floor plan, highlighted seasonal footwear collections and created a welcoming atmosphere for shoppers.

realizzazioni.kw: Footwear store refurbishment in Cosenza
realizzazioni.introduzione: Complete interior refurbishment and bespoke fixtures for an established footwear store.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For Calzature Rao in Cosenza, we managed the complete interior restyling, updating the store with a contemporary, functional furniture scheme.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: The refurbishment enhances footwear displays and shapes an inviting retail space that balances aesthetics with everyday practicality.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke restaurant and pizzeria fit-out in Rogliano
realizzazioni.introduzione: Bespoke furnishings and professional kitchen equipment for a contemporary restaurant and pizzeria.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the Jumecitu restaurant and pizzeria in Rogliano, we supplied and installed bespoke furniture and professional catering equipment, combining operational efficiency with design.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: Designed by Edoardo Carlino, the venue adopts a contemporary language shaped around both front-of-house atmosphere and kitchen workflow. Bespoke joinery and partner-brand furnishings work together to frame the guest experience.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke lounge bar fit-out in Rende
realizzazioni.introduzione: Bespoke bar furniture and kitchen equipment for a welcoming, high-efficiency lounge bar.
realizzazioni.brand_forniture: Fagor, Tecnoeka, Amitek, Metaltecnica, Agorà Mobili
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For Soft Bar in Rende, we supplied and installed the bespoke bar counter, furnishings and kitchen equipment, creating a welcoming and functional venue.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: Developed alongside owner and bartender Italo Chiappetta, the project paid close attention to service ergonomics and every detail of the guest experience.

realizzazioni.kw: Beach club bar fit-out in Scalea
realizzazioni.introduzione: Bar furnishings and commercial kitchen equipment for a coastal beach club.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For Lido da Pietro in Scalea, we delivered a complete fit-out covering the supply and installation of bar furnishings and professional kitchen equipment.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: Developed in collaboration with architect Olivia Bruno, the project unites clean aesthetics with practical durability, enhancing guest comfort and back-of-house efficiency.

realizzazioni.kw: Patisserie workshop equipment and furniture in Rende
realizzazioni.introduzione: An artisan patisserie workshop laid out for clean, efficient production workflows.
realizzazioni.brand_forniture: Zanolli, Mecnosud, Ilsa, Staf59, Metaltecnica, Offcar, FBM Boscolo, Karel
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the new Sakuralab patisserie workshop in Rende, we supplied and installed the professional equipment, planning an efficient, well-organised production environment.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: The equipment supports every stage of artisan production, from dough preparation to finished-product preservation, within a layout structured around seamless kitchen workflows.

realizzazioni.kw: Olive mill and tasting room fit-out in Cantinella
realizzazioni.introduzione: Retail space, tasting room and executive office for an olive mill housed in a stone farmhouse.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For the olive mill of Azienda Agricola Luigi Benincasa, we delivered a contract fit-out bringing together retail, tasting room and office areas inside a historic stone farmhouse.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: The tasting counter and back counter were crafted to measure; the retail area pairs iron-and-wood shelving and display tables with Gaber chairs and stools. A glazed executive office furnished with Frezza systems completes the intervention.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke mini-market furniture in Guardia Piemontese
realizzazioni.introduzione: Fixtures and retail equipment for a neighbourhood mini-market blending traditional warmth and clean contemporary lines.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For La bottega del vicinato in Guardia Piemontese, we delivered a complete fit-out, supplying and installing bespoke retail fixtures and store equipment.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: The redesign improves store circulation and product visibility, creating a welcoming, practical space for both customers and staff that balances traditional cues with modern lines.

realizzazioni.kw: Bespoke hotel guestroom furniture in Cosenza
realizzazioni.introduzione: Bespoke guestrooms for a city hotel, combining fine materials with refined furniture design.
realizzazioni.descrizione_lead: For Royal Hotel in Cosenza, we crafted the bespoke guestroom furnishings in collaboration with architect Virginia Oriolo.
realizzazioni.descrizione_testo: Selected materials and refined furniture design unite elegance and comfort, delivering warm, functional interiors tailored to guest wellbeing.
